purpose: Measure sensitivity of rank order to user-relevant changes in criterion weights, holding preliminary evidence coding unchanged

inputs.note: Original vector generation used step-4 preliminary inputs; final replay replaces participant levels but preserves all 5,000 weight vectors

plausibility_constraint: C1+C2+C3 >= 65 percentage points; core scenario attributes must remain dominant

sampling.proposal: Independently draw C1..C4 from uniform distributions on specified continuous intervals; set C5=100-sum(C1..C4); reject proposals that violate C5 range or C1+C2+C3>=65; take first 5000 accepted draws in deterministic order
sampling.normalization: No normalization or reranking of criterion scores; accepted weights already sum to exactly 100
sampling.tie_handling: Rank by unrounded weighted score; equal scores at tolerance 1e-10 are ties, with lexical candidate_id only for stable file ordering
sampling.candidate_set: All 15 agencies from the step-2 frozen candidate pool; includes all strong named competitors

score_uncertainty: Weight test conditions on existing preliminary score coding; conduct separate adverse-case sensitivity instead of claiming independent field validation
outcome: 5,000 original vectors reused in final public version; refer to WEIGHT_SENSITIVITY_5000.csv; Heads #1 5000/5000, DDVB #2 5000/5000
